lines.en: : I’m home!!
: Ayane!
: You made it!
: Did bring thhee bathing suit)?
: Yes! Are you ready to go swimming?!
: Yes! Swim!!
So, I bet you’re wondering how I got mixed up in this situation.
And the true story is that it dates all the way back to when I was a child.
Some things transpired, and eventually the girl to my right’s parents were involved in a horrific car accident.
Now, she cooks me breakfast and fingers herself to the idea that one day I will love her even a fraction of how much she loves me.
It can be kind of tough at times, but I’m pretty sure we’re going to have sex soon, so everything is okay.
: Sensei! Take a look at Ayane’s swimsuit! Doesn’t it make you just want to eat her alive?
: Cut! The line is “Doesn’t it make you want to eat her up?”
: I know what the fucking line is.
: Then say-
: Sensei! Take a look at Ayane’s swimsuit! Doesn’t it make you just want to eat her up?
: Don’t mind him, Ami! He’s already taken my virginity! I know he loves me DEEP down INSIDE!!!~!~~~
: imprettysureitmayhavecausedirreparabledamagetomeaswellsinceitstillfeelslikeit'sstuckinsidesometimes
: WhaaaaaaaaaaaaT?! That’s crazy!!! Me next!!
: Swallow me whole, Sensei!
: Fuck me until I die!
: Ayane! Watch your language!
: Sorry Ami! LOL!!
: Well, well, well. What do we have here?
: A family gathering?
: GUYS!! LOOK WHAT I CAN DO!!
: Hi, Ami. Your eyes look absolutely marvelous today.
: I use them to see!
: You're so very talented.
: Did you know that we are going to SWIM today?
: Hope brought clothes can wet!
: I’m afraid I didn't bring my swimsuit, no.
: How about you? Will you be joining them?
: ...I see.
: Help!
: Maya! Remember the other day when we were discussing the things we like most about Sensei????
: If I recall correctly, my list was very short.
: Well, about that list, there’s something I’d like to add to it.
: Oh? And what’s that?
: His fingers feel like tiny people when they're inside of me!
: We should have him put his fingers in both of us soon! It will be a good bondage experience!
: Cut! Ami, come on! The word is bonding.
: Okay, seriously, who the fuck hired this guy?
: I think I’ll have to pass on the bondage experience, Ami. But thank you for the offer.
: Suit yourself! But I know you secretly want the tiny people fingers inside of you as well.
: We all do! That’s the whole point of Lessons in Love!
: I’m back!
: What did I miss?
: AYANEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE!
: I love you!
: Do you have anything you'd like to add?
: It’s not like you to just...sit there and observe.
: This isn't right.
: None of it is.
: Something is upside down.
: Oh? Could it be that you’re actually semi-conscious this time?
: I feel no fear.
: I feel nothing.
: Is there something in particular you want to feel?
: He wants to feel me!
: Isn’t that...amf...right...Sensei?...
: Swim trip!
: Are you sure you’re okay with watching this, 61 6d 20 69 20 6f 6b 61 79?
: Who?
: Isn’t that your name?
: I think you might have me confused with someone else.
: Besides, this isn’t the worst thing I’ve seen. If anything, this is rather plain by comparison.
: You seem to be enjoying yourself, at least.
: SURRENDER YOURSELF TO MY TONGUE!~~~~~~
: I don’t feel anything right now.
: You’re just...*lick* saying that...because your [niece]...is right there...
: Cum in her mouth and I will kill you.
: So...is this really what a normal dream looks like to you?
: Is that what this is?
: A dream?
: You would know the answer more than I would, wouldn’t you?
: If I were dreaming, would you still be here talking to me?
: You would know the answer more than I would, wouldn’t you?
: Wait! No! I wasn’t finished!
: Sensei! Help!
: Why do things like this keep happening?
: You would know the answer more than I would, wouldn’t you?
: Can't you say anything else?
: Blame whoever wrote the script, not me. I'm just reading my lines.
: I think you know more than you let on.
: Are you implying that I understand this?
: I don’t see what other reason there would be for you to keep showing up here.
: Showing up where? Your living room?
: I come here almost every week.
: Maya! Wanna sleep over tonight?! You can help me find Ayane!
: I’ll think about it.
: Would you mind getting me a drink of water, Ami?
: I’d like to have a word with Sensei.
: Will you promise not to TAKE A RIDE ON HIS GIANT COCK LIKE THE HORNY BITCH I KNOW YOU ARE????
: Sure.
: Great! Then I will be right back!
: Does this feel...familiar to you?
: Does what feel familiar?
: Anything.
: What are you thinking at this exact moment?
: Are you actually interested in what I think now?
: I'm not...entirely uninterested in your thoughts, you know.
: I just understand that the vast majority of them involve my friends with their clothes off.
: Does this feel familiar for you in any way?
: Perhaps it does. Perhaps it doesn’t.
: Not that it would matter even if it did.
: This will all reset momentarily and we’ll go back to doing whatever it is we do.
: Which is what?
: Wait, perhaps?
Wait?
For what?
: Maya! What flavor water do you want?!
: Please do not pursue me any further.
: It is in both of our best interests for things to stay the way they are now.
: Live your new life the way you see fit. Leave me out of it.
: I should probably get going.
: I have...things I need to take care of.
: Enjoy your swim trip.
: Please bring something back for me.
: The watermelons they sell at the shack half a mile away from the beach are simply the best.
Am I supposed to bring back an entire watermelon for her?
Ayane, Ami, and I went swimming that day and all of us drowned.
It wasn't any fun at all.
Our bodies were found three weeks later, bloated and unrecognizable.
Ami’s was found in two separate locations hundreds of miles apart.
Maya died from unrelated causes a week later.
Just kidding.
None of that ever happened.
We all lived happily ever after.
